note: Limits per mode. active and listening: 10-minute averages. checking and away: only the seconds the camera is on (cameraOn* keys), since the running capture session alone costs about 2.9% CPU and 110 MB (docs/spikes/camera-cost.md). reading: 10 minutes idle at the desk with the real engine cycle; whole-run average CPU and peak footprint. memoryMB is the phys footprint; wakeupsPerSecond needs powermetrics.
